title: Pseudo-Smerdis stops the Temple work
summary: Jones dates a stop to the Temple repairs under the name Pseudo-Smerdis.
description: Jones dates a stop to the Temple repairs under the name Pseudo-Smerdis. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 522 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: Pseudo-Smerdis is Jones’s name. Ezra 4:24 says the work ceased unto the second year of Darius. The name is not in that verse.
